title: Assistant
subtitle: A space to think through your story.
adviserEmptyHint: Start a conversation and ask for guidance on plot, voice, or coherence.
adviserNeedsProject: Open a project to start talking with your adviser.
reviewDeactivatedHint: Review is off. The document will not be analyzed until you turn it on again.
presetLegend: How you want it to help
noProvider: The assistant is not configured right now. Contact whoever administers the account.
noPermission: Your role does not have access to these AI tools. An administrator can grant the permissions.
contextNotice: When you ask for help, excerpts from this project and your question are sent to an AI service.
fallbackNotice: If this option fails, another configured option may be used.
deleteChatConfirm: This conversation and all of its messages will be deleted.
chatEmptyHint: Start a conversation or return to one from your history. Explore motivations, structure and consistency.
messagePlaceholder: What conflict could this character explore?
webSearchHint: On: search the web. Off: this story only. Only your question is sent, not the manuscript.
appOnlyHint: Answer only from what is in this story.
copyPolicy: Responses are guidance. Copying and dragging are disabled in this view.
characterHint: Pick who to talk to and rehearse the scene: they improvise in first person and only know the story up to the point you mark.
knowledgeScopeHint: They know nothing that happens after that point.
characterIntroHint: Improvise the scene in first person. They know their sheet and the story up to {{scope}}.
suggestionsHint: Look for contradictions and loose ends. Check each observation and decide what to change in your manuscript.
draftLimit: Reviews support up to {{count}} characters per page draft. If the draft exceeds that, the saved full page text is used.
noSuggestions: No observations with sufficient evidence were found. This does not guarantee that the text has no inconsistencies.
characterCompletionHint: Extract facts from the manuscript and check their sources. Accept each field separately to replace only that value.
noExtractedFields: No new facts with sufficient evidence were found for this character.
subplotHint: Consider how each idea relates to the main plot. A subplot is only added when you accept it.

errors.session: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.permission: You no longer have permission to use this tool.
errors.rateLimit: You have reached the temporary limit. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.busy: A request is in progress. Wait before retrying.
errors.unavailable: No provider is available. Try again later.
errors.invalid: This request could not be processed. Check the character, chapter and text length.
errors.request: A response could not be retrieved. You can retry without duplicating your message.
errors.invalidResponse: The AI did not return a usable format for this stage. Press Generate with AI again.
errors.apply: The change could not be saved. Your previous content is preserved.
errors.writing: The assistant can advise you and analyze your story, but cannot write or continue the manuscript for you. Rephrase your request as a question.
errors.insufficient: There isn't enough writing in your documents yet. Write more so the AI can fill in the information.
errors.characterComplete: This sheet already has every field the AI can complete.

sceneDirectionHint: Describe your narrative intent for advice on developing it.

saver.name: Saver
saver.hint: Fewer tokens, but your writing may be used for training.
saver.warning: This option costs less because your messages and story excerpts may be used to train models. Do not use it for material you want kept out of that use.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.hint: Better quality; your writing may be used for training.
balanced.warning: This option is stronger and costs more. Your messages and story excerpts may be used to train models.

quality.name: Quality
quality.hint: Higher quality; your writing may be used for training.
quality.warning: This option favours quality and costs more. Your messages and story excerpts may be used to train models.

private.name: Private
private.hint: Zero data retention at the provider (ZDR). Your writing is not used for training.

sealed.name: Maximum privacy
sealed.hint: More expensive and lower quality; your writing is not used for training.

training.title: This option uses your text for training
training.dontShow: Don't show this again for this option

openerScene: You are waiting in the corridor. I just walked in.
openerMotive: What is going through your head right now?
openerConflict: I do not agree with you.
